basicsBar.title: Basics: bar view
basicsBar.description: Cards, search, queue and view options – in two minutes.

welcome.title: Welcome to the bar view
welcome.body: This is where you work during service: look up recipes, take orders and check them off. Here is a quick look at the essentials.

cardSelection.title: Choose a card
cardSelection.body: Choose which card is shown – or switch to the search across all cocktails or to the order view.

search.title: Search
search.body: Find any cocktail by name or ingredient. Tip: Shift + F opens the search at any time.

cocktailCard.title: Cocktail
cocktailCard.body: Each tile shows recipe, glass and price. Tap it to open all details including preparation, ratings and notes.

addToQueue.title: Add to the list
addToQueue.body: “List” puts the cocktail into the queue – optionally with a note such as “no ice”.

queue.title: Queue
queue.body: Open orders collect here. The check mark marks a cocktail as done – it then counts towards the statistics.

viewOptions.title: View options
viewOptions.body: Adjust the display here: images, tags, description, ratings and the statistic actions for list and queue.

manage.title: Manage
manage.body: The gear takes you to management: recipes, ingredients, cards and statistics. Under “Help & tutorials” you can repeat this tour at any time.

basicsManage.title: Basics: management
basicsManage.description: From ingredient to recipe to card.

welcome.title: Management
welcome.body: This is where you maintain everything shown in the bar view. Let's go from ingredient to card together.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.body: Cocktails are made of ingredients. Open the ingredient list.

createIngredient.title: New ingredient
createIngredient.body: The plus button creates an ingredient.

ingredientForm.title: Enter an ingredient
ingredientForm.body: Name, bottle price and volume are enough to start – the app calculates the cost per cocktail from them. You can save later, let's continue.

createCocktail.title: New cocktail
createCocktail.body: The plus button creates a recipe.

cocktailForm.title: Enter a recipe
cocktailForm.body: Glass, ingredients with amounts, preparation steps and price – afterwards the cocktail shows up in search and cards.

cards.title: Cards
cards.body: Cards define what the bar view shows.

createCard.title: Create a card
createCard.body: Put together groups such as “Sours” or “Highballs” and choose the days the card is active.

help.title: Help & tutorials
help.body: All tours, the setup checklist and what's new are collected here.
